title: Social draft sent for review
summary: A post is drafted for the canary client, validated against the platform rules and sent for review. Nothing is scheduled or published: the canary client has no connected account, and the run never connects one.

steps.title: Find the canary client
steps.note: Make this call NOW with exactly the input above (it carries this run's id, which the answer must echo): an answer from an earlier call, or from the previous journey, is stale because that journey's last step removed the canary.

steps.title: Draft a post

input.body: Acceptance run {{runId}}: a rehearsal draft for PiB Canary Co. Never publish.

steps.note: Do not attach or connect an account and do not set a time. If the tool refuses because the client has no connected account, report that as the error: it is a finding for the Social agent, not something to work around.

steps.title: Send the post for review
steps.note: Do not approve it. The review asks the Reviewer first when the company has one.
